description: The BigQuery adapter applies SAFE_DIVIDE through _safeguard_division_by_zero (bigquery.py). The fork exposes this as an opt-in safe_division option, off by default. The adapter must pass it explicitly so behavior is unchanged, and the change must be reviewed because a zero divisor returns NULL instead of an error, which can change published results. Logged by owner decision as a high-priority follow-up to the transpilation move.
